uslaw-usc-t2-s179l:
Section 179l of Title 2 of the United States Code directs the Librarian of Congress to continue the National Film Registry. It sits at the head of the film preservation sections of Title 2, current through Public Law 119-134. The Registry was set up under earlier film preservation acts.

The Librarian shall continue the Registry established and maintained under the National Film Preservation Act of 1988 and the Act of 1992. The work runs under sections 179l to 179w of the title. Its purpose is to maintain and preserve films that matter in culture, in history, or in art. The Registry thus stands as the Library's standing list of films held worthy of keeping.
